hooks.name: Block Push Without Lint
hooks.description: Blocks git push if lint/format checks fail

action.command:
#!/bin/zsh

# Read the command from stdin (JSON with tool parameters)
INPUT=$(cat)
COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"command":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

# Only run checks for git push commands
if [[ "$COMMAND" != *"git push"* ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Extract the working directory
CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"cwd":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [[ -z "$CWD" ]]; then
  # Try to extract from command itself or use common paths
  for dir in /Users/mathew/super-merchant /Users/mathew/Merchant-Backend /Users/mathew/super-merchant-ui /Users/mathew/merchant-fe /Users/mathew/tms-report-java; do
    if [[ "$COMMAND" == *"$dir"* ]] || [[ "$COMMAND" == *"cd $dir"* ]]; then
      CWD="$dir"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

# If we still can't determine the directory, allow the push
if [[ -z "$CWD" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

cd "$CWD" 2>/dev/null || exit 0

# Check project type and run appropriate linter
if [[ -f "pom.xml" ]]; then
  # Java/Maven project
  echo "Running Spotless check before push..." >&2
  mvn spotless:check -B -q 2>&1
  if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Spotless check failed. Run 'mvn spotless:apply -B' to fix formatting." >&2
    exit 2
  fi
elif [[ -f "package.json" ]]; then
  # Node.js project
  echo "Running lint check before push..." >&2
  npm run lint --silent 2>&1 | grep -i "error"
  if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Lint errors found. Fix them before pushing." >&2
    exit 2
  fi
fi

exit 0
